newsitem.title: USA: Advanta to end Visa, Mastercard battle-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Advanta to end Visa, Mastercard battle-WSJ.

text.p: Credit-card issuer Advanta Corp plans to give up on its legal battle with Visa U.S.A. and MasterCard International, the Wall Street Journal said Tuesday.
The company would also abandon plans to jointly market a credit card with American Express, the newspaper said, citing people familiar with the situation.
An announcement on a lawsuit settlement could come as early as this week, the paper said.
The dispute with Visa and MasterCard centred around Avanta's plans to issue a credit card tied to the American Express rewards programme.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
